# Zexton

> Zexton plans and builds custom software, SaaS platforms, web and mobile applications, cloud systems, modernization programs, and responsible AI automation.

Zexton publishes factual service information, planning guidance, indicative pricing ranges, and original long-form engineering insights. Pages do not claim unverified clients, projects, reviews, team members, vacancies, research, or guaranteed search rankings.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://zexton.com/): Overview of Zexton software product engineering.
- [Software development services](https://zexton.com/services): Product discovery, custom web applications, SaaS, React Native, AI automation, cloud, DevOps, and modernization.
- [Engineering capabilities](https://zexton.com/capabilities): Product, UX, frontend, backend, mobile, cloud, data, security, accessibility, and applied AI capabilities.
- [Software pricing](https://zexton.com/pricing): Indicative website, custom software, SaaS, and enterprise planning ranges; not instant quotations.
- [Company](https://zexton.com/company): Zexton company direction, values, service focus, and engineering principles.
- [About](https://zexton.com/about): Discovery, delivery, security, quality, handover, and operating principles.
- [Delivery and case-study standards](https://zexton.com/work): The context and verified evidence required before publishing project outcomes.
- [Collaboration model](https://zexton.com/who-we-are): Product and engineering role areas; placeholder profiles are not represented as verified employees.
- [Software planning resources](https://zexton.com/resources): Briefing, estimation, AI readiness, and production-readiness frameworks.
- [Engineering insights](https://zexton.com/insights): Original long-form articles about software products, architecture, mobile, modernization, teams, and AI.
- [Careers](https://zexton.com/careers): Future role areas and working principles; an active vacancy exists only when explicitly published.
- [Contact](https://zexton.com/contact): Project enquiry form and public contact information.
